title: Spicy Grilled Flank Steak
description: A flavorful and spicy twist on a classic grilled steak dish.
instructions: Season the flank steak with oregano, cumin, salt, and pepper.
Grill the steak for 3-5 minutes per side, or until it reaches 135°F for medium-rare.
Let the steak rest for 5 minutes before slicing it thinly against the grain.
While the steak is cooking, heat a small amount of oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until it's slightly caramelized.
Stir in the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Serve the grilled steak with the spicy onion mixture spooned over the top.
